summary.text: Ben Mostyn is the Republican candidate for Texas House of Representatives District 117 in the November 3, 2026 general election, facing Democrat Philip Cortez.
A U.S. Army veteran and realtor, he describes himself in a Ballotpedia survey as a problem solver in the San Antonio area.

paragraphs.text: Mostyn served in the U.S. Army from 1997 to 2001.
He earned an associate degree from Cochise College in 2012 and a bachelor's degree and a graduate degree from the University of Arizona, in 2012 and 2017.
His listed career experience is as a realtor.

In a Ballotpedia survey completed in 2023, Mostyn's biography said he was a Certified Master Instructor for the Department of Defense, had spent nearly five years deployed, mostly in Afghanistan, and now works as a realtor in the San Antonio area.
The survey listed his key messages as America First, energy independence and securing the border.
Mostyn advanced from the Republican primary on March 3, 2026.
